QuestInfo.name: A Message from Coney
QuestInfo.0: Just as you're about to call him, Coney radios you. Answer his call.
QuestInfo.1: Coney says you need to run back to the hideout. Something isn't right. Return to #bGen's Hideout#k.
QuestInfo.2: Mr. Hazard's lackey taunted you over the radio. Go to the #bBrawl 'n' Bash Club#k.

0.msg: Hey, Coney? The weapon part you sent me after isn't here!\r\n

1.msg: #b(Coney said that the last piece of the weapon is actually a #k#rliving person#k#b.)#k\r\n

2.msg: Everyone's headed for Mr. Hazard's hideout... this is getting really dangerous.\r\n

3.msg: Are Antuin and Anzu at the p-pawn shop? It b-bothers me that the report mentioned their shop specifically...\r\n

6.msg: Hey! Are you still there? I have a bad feeling about this... I better get back to the hideout.\r\n

yes.0: I have a feeling things are about to get... complicated.\r\n

1.1: ...Not a peep. Where did everyone go?\r\n
1.2: The radio! Could it be Coney?\r\n

0.msg: Hee hee, surprised that your friend is gone? We took your weakling friend, and the members of your branch.\r\n

1.msg: We hear you got our weapon parts. We got need of them, so you're gonna hand them over.\r\n

2.msg: Your pals are gonna be put down for trying to stab Mr. Hazard in the back. Nothing you can do 'bout that...\r\n

3.msg: But you be a good kid and hand over the parts, and you can still save yourself.\r\n

4.msg: ...You're being pretty quiet over there. Thinking of trying to be a big hero? You know better than that, don't you?\r\n

5.msg: Your job is to drop the parts off at the Brawl 'n' Bash Club and leave. Then our business will be done, and you get to go on living your miserable little life.\r\n

7.msg: I don't think I like your attitude. You want me to lose my temper?\r\n

8.msg: Heh, I'm always up for a fight. Better hurry to the #bBrawl 'n' Bash Club#k.\r\n #r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

default.0: Hey! Are you still there? I have a bad feeling about this... I better get back to the hideout.\r\n
